what: every space/3.1 key at once
brief as a path, as in space/3
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md

what: brief as its file, with refs
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: { file: BRIEF.md, refs: [docs/design.md] }

what: brief as its text, no refs
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: { text: "Fix the build" }

what: a preset by name; a fenced agent on the Mac with its own network
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
network: standard
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code, network: { preset: open } }

what: an agent in a sandbox whose network equals the workspace's (a name and its map form are the same)
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
network: locked
sandboxes:
  vm: {}
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code, where: "sandbox:vm", network: { preset: locked } }

what: agent_defaults.where: sandbox (the workspace's own VM)
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
agent_defaults: { where: sandbox }
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code }

what: an adopted sandbox's agent, with a role and labels
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
agents:
  old: { external: { sandbox: old-review }, role: reviewer, labels: { team: qa } }

what: lifetime held under x-dozable: no note, not required
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
x-dozable: { lifetime: standing }
folders:
  scratch: { x-dozable: { lifetime: run } }

what: a top-level title reads, with a note naming about.title
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
title: App

notes.message: title is read for this release only: space/3.1 writes it as about.title (about: { title: … })

what: the x-dozable forms read for one release, each with a note

notes.message: x-dozable.brief is read for this release only: write brief: at the top level
x-dozable.about is read for this release only: write about: at the top level
x-dozable.network is read for this release only: write network: at the top level
x-dozable.layout is read for this release only: write layout: at the top level
folder "repo": x-dozable.main is read for this release only: write main: on folder "repo"
agent "h": x-dozable.restart is read for this release only: write restart: on agent "h"
agent "h": x-dozable.network is read for this release only: write network: on agent "h"
agent "old": x-dozable.external is read for this release only: write external: on agent "old"
x-dozable.isolation: vm is space/3.1's agent_defaults.where: sandbox

what: a space/3 file whose brief is under x-dozable (as written before 3.1): read as before, a note for each 3.1 key naming space/3.1, none for lifetime

notes.message: x-dozable.brief is read for this release only: write brief: at the top level, under doz: space/3.1
folder "repo": x-dozable.main is read for this release only: write main: on folder "repo", under doz: space/3.1

what: a space/3.1 file extends a space-defaults/3 file
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
extends: ./defaults.yaml

what: a space/3.1 file extends a space-defaults/3.1 file (agent_defaults.where: sandbox)
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
extends: ./defaults.yaml
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code }

what: an agent in the workspace's VM whose network equals the effective one (no workspace network: standard, Dozable's default)
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
agent_defaults: { where: sandbox }
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code, network: standard }

what: a top-level lifetime
yaml:

space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
lifetime: standing

problem.message: "lifetime" is not a space/3.1 key: it stays under x-dozable
problem.hint: write x-dozable: { lifetime: standing } (standing or runs)

what: a per-resource lifetime

folders:

problem.message: "lifetime" is not a space/3.1 key: it stays under x-dozable
problem.hint: write x-dozable: { lifetime: run } (run is the one value here)

problem.hint: this file says doz: space/3, which has no "about" here; space/3.1 reads every space/3 key the same

what: external: { sandbox } in a space/3 file

space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md

  old: { external: { sandbox: s } }

problem.message: "external" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
problem.hint: this file says doz: space/3, whose external agent is { bot: NAME }, { session: NAME } or a full name; { sandbox: NAME } is space/3.1's

what: agent_defaults.where: sandbox in a space/3 file
yaml:

space: t
owner: ada

problem.message: "where" is a space/3.1 key: change the version line to doz: space/3.1
problem.hint: this file says doz: space/3, whose where is mac or sandbox:NAME; where: sandbox (the workspace's own VM) is space/3.1's

what: a space/3 file extends a space-defaults/3.1 file
yaml:
doz: space/3
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
extends: ./defaults.yaml

problem.message: defaults.yaml is not a defaults file for a space/3 file
problem.hint: a doz: space/3 file extends doz: space-defaults/3 files: change this file's version line to doz: space-defaults/3, or the space file's to doz: space/3.1

what: both forms of one key

problem.message: "about" is written twice: about: and x-dozable.about
problem.hint: keep about: — the x-dozable form is read for this release only

what: an agent external twice: external: and x-dozable.external
yaml:

space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
agents:
  old: { external: { bot: b }, x-dozable: { external: { sandbox: s } } }

problem.message: "old" is external twice: external: and x-dozable.external
problem.hint: an agent is one external thing: keep one of them

owner: ada
brief: B.md

problem.message: unknown key "colour" in x-dozable

what: an unfenced agent with a network of its own
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code, isolation: unfenced, network: open }

problem.message: "h" is unfenced, so it has no network of its own
problem.hint: an unfenced agent acts as you: nothing enforces a network for it. Remove network:, or fence it (isolation: fenced)

what: an agent in a sandbox with a network unlike the workspace's
yaml:
doz: space/3.1
space: t
owner: ada
brief: B.md
network: standard
sandboxes:
  vm: {}
agents:
  h: { kind: claude-code, where: "sandbox:vm", network: open }

problem.message: "h" runs in sandbox vm, whose network is the workspace's (standard): it can't have its own
problem.hint: everything in a VM shares its network: remove network:, or set the workspace's network:

  h: { kind: claude-code, network: open }

problem.message: "h" runs in the workspace's VM, whose network is the workspace's (standard, Dozable's default): it can't have its own
problem.hint: everything in a VM shares its network: remove network:, or set the workspace's network:
